items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: You heard talk of Steve Lewis, huh? Yeah. He was a great piano player himself.

ctx.x: And clarinet? And trumpet? You heard talk of Steve Lewis, huh? Yeah.
He was a great piano player himself. Now, Steve was no real eater.
He was a great piano player, but he'd bust up there, he got to fooling with that stuff
